title: The Maharashtra National Law University Act, 2014.
full_text: The Maharashtra National Law University Act, 2014. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20146 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 2014-03-20 Act Year: 2014 Short Title: The Maharashtra National Law University Act, 2014. Long Title: An Act to establish and incorporate National Law Universities in the State for the development and advancement of legal education and for the purposes of imparting specialized and systematic instruction, training and research in systems of law and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Higher and Technical Education Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
